summary: BeLive Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CEO and Chairman Kenneth Teck Chuan Tan, effective after a three-month notice period ending October 3, 2026, and the appointment of CFO Abdul Latif Bin Zainal as interim CEO and Chairman starting October 4, 2026. The resignation was not due to any disagreement. Mr. Bin Zainal will continue as CFO until a permanent CEO is hired. This is a sudden departure and replacement of the top two board/executive roles, categorized as a management change. No financial terms, deal structure, or regulatory clocks are involved. Watch for potential strategic shifts or further management turnover.
